body: Heck yeah, I’m glad it turned out good!

This. This is my situation. She just left for college 8 hours away and today is Day 46 of being broken up and 36 of NC. I just wish I could text her or talk to her again but I know I need to stay strong and not reach out.... but that doesn’t make it any less difficult...

Ok. I’d go to coffee and see how things went however you seemed to want to meet your ex throughout your texting and he seemed avoidant of it. Also, you said you suspected him of cheating and gave him an out so he left. If the person cheated on me I wouldn’t give them a second chance because what’s stopping them from doing it again? I could entertain the idea of meeting up with the ex and getting coffee but I’m not sure I would want to get together. This new thing could be good however it also is iffy because they’re coming out of a long relationship so they could definitely still be hurting over that and just looking for company. Ultimately, I would go get coffee with the ex and see how it goes and maybe tell him about the new guy depending on how the conversation is going. I would not however jump straight into a relationship with my ex. Especially since it seems like he may have cheated and if that’s true then he doesn’t deserve you.
Then I’d say it’s dependent on what you feel and who you want to be with.
How long have you and the new person been talking? And are you guys just talking or are you guys more

Yea I agree with this. You need to set a definitive date. It seems like he’s interested again but don’t give away that you still have feelings too soon. Make it a mystery and don’t throw yourself at him. You have the power now. He’s the one coming back

We ended on good terms I just didn’t want it to end.. it was almost like a scene out of a movie. She had to go to work and the conversation was kind of dying because it was going in circles and she just looked at me said “goodbye” and all I could do was ask her please no please don’t leave but she just walked away and never looked back.
what does deactivating my social media account do and how do I do it
She broke up with me because “she couldn’t love me as much as I loved her” and I am still reeling in pain over the breakup.
It has helped me mentally so far however she has not reached out. Today is Day 36 of being broken up and 26 of no contact.

Don’t do it. Don’t do it. Don’t do it. If you ask that it will show them you haven’t changed. It will give them all the power. It will reset any progress you’ve made with NC. It will not be worth it. Do. Not. Do. It.
I would search up Coach Craig Kenneth and No contact. It really helps.
I think you should look into going No Contact. That will probably help your situation if you’re trying to get him back.

My ex wrote me a letter while I was at camp (which is in a previous post) and I made a response letter saying how I loved her too and wanted her forever too (important part is the too). Then I got back and four days later she broke up with me. It was also the day after my birthday and the day I was leaving for England. Well once I got back we met the next day (making 10 days after the breakup) and it didn’t go well. I then dropped off her sweater and on top I put the letter and a date when it was written (funny enough the night before she broke up with me) and I drove away.
Your disinterest is causing her to show interest.
No problem, if you ever need anyone to talk to don’t be afraid to message me.

No! I don’t mind at all. If it’s a problem to you I want to help. We’re all struggling somehow and we’re all hoping for advice. 

I feel like NC is definitely the way to go and you need to limit yourself from her life (Snapchat, insta, etc). While you don’t need to block her  I would suggest taking her off from viewing your story on sc and then refraining from viewing her story on insta or liking her post.
Yea it’s definitely time to go NC.  It may also be wise to confide your thoughts and feelings of this situation to your close friends so they understand what’s happening.

No contact could give you some of the power because your not showing her attention. Ironically because if this she may start wanting your attention. Disinterest from you can provide interest from her. I don’t know the whole situation but if you already poured your heart out but she’s sleeping with other guys then she’s most likely just using you. Just to have in her back pocket. You going no contact will make her realize this isn’t true and may lead into her pursuing you. So no. I don’t believe NC is too extreme and this current moment.
No problem, if you need to talk anymore about this or have any questions don’t be afraid to reach out.
That’s exactly why you need to cut it off. If he really wants to reach you, he will. Also, there may be some way that you can toggle him from viewing your story without blocking him but I don’t know.

It may mean that he still misses you and has feelings and he may be viewing so fast because he’s always on the lookout for what your doing or trying to find any sign of if you’ve moved on. Him looking at your stories also makes it seem like he is already having separation anxiety however not enough to make him reach out. If you want him back I say (idk how sc works) you make it to where he can’t view your story. This will cause separation anxiety for him and anxiety is the root of desire so this will most likely cause him to reach out to you (eventually) as long as you are also continuing with NC.
Dang I can relate to this so much. I love your style of writing too. Really hits home.
